title: O, When Shall I See Jesus

sections.name: Verse 1
lines: [Em]O when shall I see Jesus, and reign with Him above,
[G]And shall hear the [Am]trumpet sound in [Em]that morning?

sections.name: Verse 2
lines: [Em]Gird on the gospel armor of faith and hope and love,
[G]And you'll hear the [Am]trumpet sound in [Em]that morning.

sections.name: Verse 3
lines: [Em]Our ears shall hear with transport the host of heaven sing,
[Em]Our tongues shall chant the glories of [D]our immortal King.
[G]And shall hear the [Am]trumpet sound in [Em]that morning,
